branches.stop-and-report: Stop without further input and write the fixed L2 packet for the VM supervisor.
branches.rederive-layout-and-stop: Do not use these coordinates. Ask the VM supervisor to derive a new named plan from a fresh observation.

branches.reground-menu-and-retry-once: Freshly inspect the menu state; one named retry is allowed, and a second failure at S2 goes to L3.

branches.bind-successor-and-stop-on-uncertainty: Use windows and a fresh observe to bind the expected editor. Never repeat Save.
